issuer.name: Rain (Visa Principal Member); programme operated by Paera LLC

funding.supported_assets_note: The main assets stay in the non-custodial Tangem Wallet; 'you can only spend the balance loaded on the card'. The card balance 'is held in a smart contract account that you control' (product page FAQ) and USDC/USDT can be withdrawn back to the wallet at any time. Top-up routes: swap any stablecoin from the Tangem Wallet; send USDC or USDT on Polygon, Base, BNB Smart Chain or Arbitrum to the deposit address; USD by ACH or FedWire from a US bank account. At payment 'the equivalent stablecoin amount is deducted', settled in USD via Visa. Custody modelled as hybrid: user-controlled smart-contract balance inside a programme run by Paera LLC (onboarding, KYC and AML per the tariff).

variants.region_label: US and select countries (LATAM, APAC, MEA, Africa) — list not published

eligibility.usage_note: Product page FAQ: 'Tangem Pay is available in the US and in select countries across LATAM, APAC, MEA, and Africa. Not all countries or US states are supported.' No country list is published; eligibility is checked by entering the country during in-app onboarding; requirements: a Tangem Wallet, 'a valid government-issued ID, and a home address in a supported country'. Tariff footnote 3: 'Eligibility is set by country and region of residence. Availability is shown in the mobile app.' Europe (EEA/UK) is not named among the regions. 'Additional countries planned (subject to eligibility)' lists none. Legal agreements referenced at paera.com/tangempay (plain text, not read).

kyc.thresholds_note: Product page FAQ: identity verification 'is required for all cardholders as a legal compliance requirement'; 'Identity verification is handled by Rain, the card issuer' with Sumsub (ID verification) and Elliptic (transaction monitoring); a valid government-issued ID and a home address in a supported country are required. Tariff: Paera LLC 'is responsible for onboarding, KYC and AML'. Document list beyond the ID (selfie, proof of address) not stated. If verification is rejected, the Tangem Wallet 'is not affected'.
kyc.stages_note: Verification during in-app onboarding before the card is issued ('within 5 minutes in most cases … up to 48 hours'). Tariff footnote 1: limits depend on 'verification level'.

editorial.summary: Visa card attached to the Tangem hardware wallet, issued by Rain and operated by Paera LLC (US). Available in the US and 'select countries' in LATAM, APAC, MEA and Africa — no list published, Europe not named. The card balance (USDC/USDT, user-controlled smart-contract account) is loaded from the wallet or by US bank transfer and spent in USD. Basic is free (ATM 4%, FX Visa rate + 1.5%, ACH top-up $1); Plus costs $29.99/month (ATM 2%, free bank top-ups, Visa Signature perks). Advertised cashback 1% / 2% in USDC with $100 / $300 monthly caps — the August blog said cashback would arrive in a later release and the October tariff does not mention it, so treat it as unconfirmed. KYC by Rain/Sumsub required for all cardholders.
good_for: Tangem Wallet owners in the US or a supported LATAM/APAC/MEA/Africa country who want to spend stablecoins from a balance they control
US users who top up in dollars: ACH $1 (free on Plus) and the card settles in USD without FX
not_for: Residents of the EEA, UK or Switzerland — not named among the supported regions
Anyone without a Tangem hardware wallet: 'Tangem Pay can only be linked to a Tangem Wallet'
Frequent non-USD spenders: Visa rate + 1.5% FX on every foreign-currency purchase
watch_outs: Cashback status unconfirmed: product page lists 1% / 2%, blog (Aug 2026) says 'arrives in a later app release', tariff (Oct 2026) is silent.
FX fee 1.5% in the dated tariff vs 1% in the tiers blog; delivery cost ranges differ between documents and 'the exact cost is shown in the app'.
Physical card marked 'coming soon, subject to eligibility' on the product page; Plus 'currently waitlisted' per the blog.
Prestige ($999/year, 4% cashback, 1% ATM, lounges) is 'coming soon' — not modelled.
ATM: 3 withdrawals per 24 h, $250 each; operator fees not addressed; limits 'may differ per cardholder'.
Tangem AG (Zug) disclaims the card programme; disputes, verification and refunds go to Paera LLC (support@paera.com). The Paera legal agreements were not read.
Dispute fee $30; refunds can take 3–14 business days, up to 30 days.
